en.description:
Roll through 100 hand-tuned mazes using nothing but your wrist. Tilt to steer, beat the clock, and unlock a cast of eight characters along the way.

Avo & Cado was built for Apple Watch rather than shrunk down to fit it. There are no buttons, no on-screen sticks, and no phone in your hand. You tilt, the seed rolls, and the maze answers instantly.

A HUNDRED MAZES, TUNED BY HAND
Easy teaches you how everything works. Normal makes you pay attention. Hard and Extreme will take more than one try. Every level in the game was drawn, tested, and tuned before it shipped, and every one of them has a par time worth chasing.

THREE STARS ARE EARNED, NOT GIVEN
Match par for two stars. Beat it comfortably for three. Ties always go in your favour.

EIGHT CHARACTERS TO COLLECT
Stars unlock the cast. Volcado leaves a trail of embers behind him. Cado bursts into hearts when she wins. Hass never puts the barbell down. One character cannot be unlocked with stars at any price, and you will know that one when you see it.

BUILT TO RESPECT YOU
No accounts. No ads. No trackers. No data collection of any kind. Your times, your stars, and your progress stay on your watch, where they belong.

Made by one person, tested by two very honest kids.
en.subtitle: Fun Tilt Mazes for your wrist
